findings.detail: The source schedule uses industry/type headers, blank spacer rows, subtotals, cash equivalents, other assets/liabilities, and net assets rows in addition to the 23 actual investment line items; those non-position rows explain the source-count side of E07.

rationale: False alarm. The raw 2025 schedule localizes to 23 actual investment rows: 17 line items in table 251 and 6 preferred-stock line items in table 252. Those line items roll through the cited category totals to Total Investments of $37,591,400, matching the output fund_quarter_fv_m anchor of 37.591400. The E07 source=52 count is therefore counting non-position schedule structure rather than missing output positions.
